system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I need help with an upcoming trip from New York to Chicago. I'd like to change the passenger to myself, upgrade it to economy class, and add 3 checked bags.

I can help with that. To modify a reservation, I first need:

1. Your user ID  
2. Your reservation ID

Also, please confirm whether by “New York to Chicago” you mean an existing reservation you want to modify.

Once I have the IDs, I’ll check the booking and then help with:
- changing the passenger information to you
- changing the cabin to economy
- adding 3 checked bags

If you don’t know the reservation ID, give me your user ID and I can help locate it.
My user ID is omar_rossi_1241. Yes, it’s an existing reservation I want to modify.

Thanks. Please provide your reservation ID.

If you don’t know it, I can look it up using your user ID.
I don’t know the reservation ID. Could you look it up using my user ID?

I found these reservation IDs on your account:

- UM3OG5
- 5RJ7UH
- FQ8APE
- QKRY03

Please tell me which reservation is the New York to Chicago trip.
Could you tell me which one is the New York to Chicago trip?

Yes — your New York to Chicago trip is:

- Reservation ID: FQ8APE
- Route: EWR to ORD
- Trip type: one way
- Current cabin: basic economy
- Passenger: Ivan Garcia, DOB 1960-12-01
- Flights:
  - HAT056 on 2024-05-25: EWR to IAH

Before we proceed, please note:
- Passenger changes are allowed, and the number of passengers cannot change.
- Cabin can be changed from basic economy to economy if no flight has been flown.
- Bags can be added.
- Because you are a gold member, economy includes 3 free checked bags per passenger.

To continue, please confirm the new passenger details for yourself:
- First name
- Last name
- Date of birth

Also, for the cabin change, any fare difference or refund may apply. If needed for payment or refund, please tell me which one payment method already in your profile you want to use:
- gift_card_8190333

- certificate_8390038

Once you provide your passenger details and payment method, I’ll summarize the changes and ask for your final yes before making them.

First name: Omar  
Last name: Rossi

I’d prefer to use a gift card for any payment.

Thanks. I still need your date of birth to update the passenger.

Also, please choose one gift card already on your profile for any payment or refund related to the cabin change:
- gift_card_8190333
- gift_card_6490722

Once you provide:
1. Date of birth
2. Which gift card to use

I’ll list the modification details and ask for your final confirmation.
I’d rather not provide my date of birth since it should already be in my profile. Please use gift_card_8190333.

I can use the date of birth already on your profile.

Important note:

- If the economy fare is higher than the original fare, any difference will be charged to gift_card_8190333.
- If the economy fare is lower, the difference will be refunded to gift_card_8190333.

Please reply yes to proceed.
